messages:
Jordan: ok quick reminder for anyone who missed the saga at the office meetup — The Great Macaroon Incident happened again 😂
Priya: wait what happened this time? did Hank bring cookies or chaos?
Hank: i brought macarons (french spelling, fight me) and someone nuked them for 12 minutes. steam explosion.
Sam: 12 minutes??? who? that’s a war crime against pastries.
Hank: i allegedly misread 12s as 12m on the microwave. the label said 'do not overheat' which i... overlooked.
Tess: (posts GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/oops-awkward-3oEduXg1s9W6W)
Priya: i still say it counts as performance art. the macaroon achieved singularity.
Jordan: security note: there is now a crater in the communal plate. archeologists may excavate. :t_rex:
Reacji Bot: added :hankaroon: emoji to the workspace (reaction: :heart:)
Sam: we need to decide on Hank's canonical office nickname. proposals: "Hankaroon", "MacHank", "The Steamroller"
Hank: i accept "Hankaroon" and will wear it with pride. pls no tattoos yet.
Tess: i vote sticker + tiny embroidered patch for laptop sleeves.
Priya: also can we add a line to the kitchen rules: "Do not microwave macarons for >20s unless you want a memorial" (laughing)
Jordan: poll time — Sticker? Patch? Both? None? (react with :thumbsup: sticker, :tada: patch, :heart: both, :no_entry_sign: none)
Sam: :thumbsup:
Priya: :heart:
Hank: :tada: (i voted patch ngl)
Tess: :heart:
Jordan: decision: both. production run of 50 "Hankaroon" stickers. who’s in charge of design? Priya?
Priya: i will whip up something this weekend. minimalist, a macaroon wearing tiny safety goggles.
Hank: truly my couture era.
Reacji Bot: pinned message to #random: "Hankaroon lore — microwaving memorialized"
Sam: future onboarding chapter idea: "Do not microwave Hank". add to handbook?
Jordan: yes but maybe phrased gently: "Respect pastries and coworker reputations"
Tess: this thread is officially lore. new tradition: on birthdays Hank gets a personally un-microwaved dessert.
Hank: i will accept surprise desserts and remorse. thanks for keeping it light y'all :pray:
